about.text: Barbara Moore, Vanessa Reed, and Christine Burrell appeal from a judgment of the Jefferson Circuit Court, Bessemer Division ("the trial court"), granting a writ of quo warranto and a petition for a permanent injunction filed by Robin Sims, the mayor of the City of Lipscomb, purportedly on behalf of the State of Alabama, that removed Moore, Reed, and Burrell from their offices as members of the Lipscomb City Council due to their failure to meet residency requirements pursuant to statutory law.

caseName: Barbara Moore, Vanessa Reed, and Christine Burrell v. State of Alabama ex rel. Mayor Robin Sims, as informant
